title: Pipeline: why Good
angle: Open on Pixabay surf footage (218670_large.mp4) with the hook, then the phone swings in showing spot-pipeline.png. Push in on the green Good badge. The Size, Period and Wind bars light up one at a time; Size and Period run long, the Wind bar stops short and a card reads "wind can only polish". End card: logo, "rosa.surf, link in bio", "Footage: Pixabay".
cta: link in bio (rosa.surf on the end card)

voiceover.script: Pipeline said Good this morning, not Epic. I tapped it to see why. Size and period were pumping, but the wind wasn't there. Fair call.
